name: Halt Death
body:
Discipline: psychometabolism; Level mender 0

MANIFESTING

Manifesting Time: 1 standard action
Display: material

EFFECT

Range: 30 ft.
Target: 1 living creature
Duration: instantaneous
Saving Throw: Will negates (harmless); Power Resistance: yes (harmless)
Power Points: psionic focus or 1

DESCRIPTION

You can target one member of your collective that is dying (at -1 hp or less). That creature is automatically stabilized and does not lose any further hit points. If the creature later takes damage, it continues dying normally.
